title: Add `API.moveRepo()` to the frontend API client
description:
Plan Context: Replace the inline add form and full-page detail editor with a single shared modal dialog that supports moving repositories between stores via a dropdown integrated into the save flow.

Description: Add a `moveRepo(repoId, targetStoreId)` method to the API client's Repos group so the frontend modal can invoke the move endpoint.

Scope:
- `mcp-server/gui/public/api-client.js` — Repos group

Deliverables:
- `API.moveRepo(repoId, targetStoreId)` function that calls `POST /repos/:repoId/move` with `{ target_store_id: targetStoreId }`.

Estimated Complexity: Low

acceptance_criteria.criterion: `API.moveRepo(repoId, targetStoreId)` sends a POST to `/repos/{repoId}/move` with `{ target_store_id }` and returns the parsed response.
The `repoId` parameter is URI-encoded in the path.

summary: Added `API.moveRepo(repoId, targetStoreId)` to the Repos group in `api-client.js`. The method calls `POST /repos/{repoId}/move` with `{ target_store_id: targetStoreId }`, URI-encodes `repoId` in the path, and returns the parsed response via the shared `request()` helper. Inserted between `deleteRepo` and the Stores section to maintain logical grouping. No build step required (plain JS file). All 4029 MCP server tests pass.

comments.note: No observations — code in the touched files is clean and consistent. The existing Repos group pattern (encodeURIComponent + request()) is well-established and was applied consistently.

summary: Verified AC1: API.moveRepo(repoId, targetStoreId) calls request('POST', '/repos/' + encodeURIComponent(repoId) + '/move', { target_store_id: targetStoreId }). The request() helper sets Content-Type: application/json, JSON-encodes the body, and returns res.json() on success.
Verified AC2: repoId is passed through encodeURIComponent() — consistent with all other Repos group methods (createRepo, updateRepo, deleteRepo).
Confirmed backend endpoint POST /api/repos/:repoId/move is registered in server.ts (WP-002). The [^/]+ regex correctly matches percent-encoded IDs; server decodeURIComponents the param.
Edge case: repoId containing '/' encodes to '%2F', which the backend regex still matches and decodes correctly. Verified no conflict with the /move path segment.
Regression: 4031/4031 tests pass across 145 test files. No regressions introduced.

comments.note: No bugs found. The implementation is minimal, consistent with the existing Repos group pattern (encodeURIComponent + request()), and correctly matches the backend route signature.

summary: WP-003 passes code review. API.moveRepo() is minimal, consistent, and correct. The JSDoc comment matches the backend contract; encodeURIComponent is applied consistently with all other Repos group methods.

comments.note: No observations — code is clean and consistent. The implementation is exactly one line, follows the Repos group pattern, and the JSDoc matches the backend contract precisely.

summary: Updated two manifest documentation files to record the new `API.moveRepo()` frontend method added in WP-003. (1) api-surface.md: removed the stale "40 REST endpoints" count (per no-stale-counts policy) and added a Repos group entry to the `**API**` bullet, documenting all six Repos methods (listRepos, getRepo, createRepo, updateRepo, deleteRepo, moveRepo) with their endpoint signatures and the multi-store constraint on moveRepo. (2) file-tree.md: added the Repos group annotation to the api-client.js comment line with all six methods and the WP-003 provenance tag. The inline JSDoc on the method was already complete (as noted by the Reviewer), so no changes were needed to api-client.js itself.

comments.note: The api-surface.md API bullet was also missing the Knowledge group (getKnowledge, updateKnowledge, deleteKnowledge, promoteKnowledge, moveKnowledge), getChunkText, orchestratorGetRunStatus, and the Store management group (addStore, importStore, updateStore, removeStore, setDefaultStore, reorderStores). These gaps predate WP-003 and are out of scope here, but flagged for a future documentation maintenance pass.

notes: WP-003 passes QA. API.moveRepo() is correctly implemented in mcp-server/gui/public/api-client.js (line 592). Both ACs are met: POST to /repos/{encodedRepoId}/move with { target_store_id }, returning parsed response. Backend endpoint confirmed present. 4031/4031 tests pass.
WP-003 PASS. API.moveRepo() is a clean one-liner consistent with the established Repos group pattern. Documentation agent: the JSDoc on the method is present and complete — no gaps to fill.
